notes: chained-cast composition (ADR-0011): date::datetime is midnight UTC, and this is the supported spelling of a date-shaped string cast to datetime
float::integer truncates toward zero, deliberately diverging from PostgreSQL's rounding, to match Elixir trunc/JavaScript Math.trunc/Ruby to_i - -1.5 truncates to -1, not -2
the ISA has no truthiness rule and casts do not open a side door between booleans and numbers
the happy path: a whole-string decimal integer parses
the totality rule (ADR-0011): a conversion that cannot produce a value of the target type pushes :undefined, never an error

the propagation rule (ADR-0011): :undefined::type is :undefined for every target. user.missing is a genuine :undefined from an access miss, not a load of an absent root, which errors under the default on_unbound policy (see errors.json) and is a separate concern from cast's own semantics
